Insert a wallet movement for a business. Requires the **admin key**; refuses businesses outside its network. `wallettransactiontypeid` 1 = Credit, 2 = Debit; `walletfundmodeid` 1/2/3. `createdby` is optional (numeric user id; defaults to 0).
